content: Alice, is that you? It's been 10 years.
It sure has. What are you doing nowadays? Are you still taking pictures?
As a matter of fact I am. After finishing university, I went to work as a photographer. How about you? You are always so good in art class. I guess you are a famous painter now, right?
Well, actually I'm a designer and I do most of my work on computers now, but I still like to paint on the weekends.
